regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, two-theme leadership structure (Banks and Innovative Pharma & CXO, both crowded) with wide but very thin rotation breadth (4 of 22 eligible). Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the detector's one validated drawdown edge is absent here; rotation/rank signals are display-only. Given the 55.8% hit rate but only 37.7% directional accuracy over 77 calls, conviction is capped.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) closes the 0.01 rotation-margin gap to Banks AND holds breadth above 0.6 — a confirmed handoff would retire this watch; if the margin widens back above 0.10 over a week, the watch is retired as the two-theme structure persists.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead the ranks (score 0.998), are eligible, and show the highest durability_bar (0.73) and broadest participation (breadth 0.889). This is the only theme with genuine breadth, which argues the leadership is not a single-name artifact. Lean overweight is a direction on established leadership, not a return forecast — the rank itself carries no alpha, but the breadth-plus-durability combination supports staying with the leader over de-risking into laggards.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 (size-down caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: with a crowding_z of 1.78 and 'crowded: true', Banks is the most-owned theme; attention spikes have marked tops historically, and a mean-reverting A-share tape can whipsaw even broad leadership abruptly.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% over any 10-trading-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The challenger to Banks (score 0.988, rotation margin just 0.01) has solid durability (0.60) and moderate breadth (0.643), and is also eligible. This is a co-leader, not yet a confirmed handoff — but its close proximity to the leader and reasonable breadth makes it a legitimate second pillar in a two-theme tape rather than something to underweight.
theses.dissent: breadth 0.643 is meaningfully lower than Banks' 0.889, and crowded=true (z 1.59) means the theme is already well-owned; a marginally different regime could see it revert below the trend gate.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% over any 10-trading-day stretch before the check-by date
